title: Objectwise normalized completed-pullback fibre comparisons
statement: Let k be a field, l a prime invertible in k, and R a continuous rational realization family [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization]. For all separated finite-type k-schemes X and all finite coefficient fields A/Q_l, there is a family ω of normalized exact fibres as in [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-exactness]. For every g:Y→X, algebraically closed geometric point y:Spec κ→Y and heart object F, there is an A-linear isomorphism from ω_y(g*F) to ω_(y g)(F). These objectwise isomorphisms satisfy the unit germ normalization on every degree-zero presentation and the integral local normalization on every specified affine open of a pulled adapted lattice chart: its target system is the literal etale inverse image of the source reduction system; δ is the finite reduction-unit mate; q is fixed by the realized derived counit germ equation; η agrees with δ on rationalized integral sections; ψ=q followed by pullback of φ and η; and the component is the conjugate of the rationalized inverse limit of pullTowerIso. Identity, composition and naturality in F are not asserted. The full quantified data and equations are ObjectwiseNormalizedPullback in the Lean attachment. The coefficient and module constructions are those of [def-per-adic-fibre-comparison-data] and [def-per-adic-fibre-coherence-data], without changing any of them.

proof.text: Use finite-type noetherianity and the uniform fibre-dimension bound to justify the continuous realization and normalized fibre exactness at every base. Apply normalized fibre exactness and retain intrinsic lattice-normalized fibres simultaneously in A and X.

Realization and the universal derived counit identify pullback on a heart object with ordinary module inverse image. On each pulled trivializing chart, the finite free degree-zero module is a flat resolution and balanced tensor multiplies scalars. Compose inverse images to Spec κ and evaluate at its final object, then conjugate by the intrinsic fibre isomorphisms to define the objectwise comparison. The same counit applied to any degree-zero presentation gives its normalized germ formula.

Pull back the adapted stratification and the original etale chart, then restrict to the specified affine open W₀. Take its scheme for D and the two pullback projections for D.map and f; the lifted point and all geometric equations follow from the pullback universal property. Reconstruct M from the literal etale inverse-image reduction system by the lisse completed-system comparison. Its limit cone defines δ, with the required finite reduction-unit mate; rational balanced tensor defines η with the integral-section formula. The restriction comparison q comes from the same counit; its unit-composition germ equation fixes q, and ψ is the displayed composite.

Finite inverse-image stalk comparisons give pullTowerIso with its transition equations. Its limit isomorphism has the required projection equation by HasLimit.isoOfNatIso_hom_π. The chosen intrinsic local-lattice identifications identify the rationalized limit map with the component defined above. This pulls finite reductions to the point before taking the limit and does not commute a stalk with an inverse limit.
